title: Tops and Bottoms: The Lock Call, pilot

lines.text: [bright] Good morning from The Window at Hardwood Bricks. This is Tops and Bottoms, the Lock Call. I'm Leslie Phyllis.

[upbeat] And I'm Brett Busberger, Mr. JuiceBox. Leslie, did you see the White House briefing this week? The president brings out his new chief of staff, Stephen Miller, and says, quote, he was better than these two guys.
The two guys being the vice president and the secretary of state. Standing right behind him! [laughs] Honey, I've seen kinder benchings in the SWAC.
Then he asks Miller if he wants to run for president. That's not a depth chart, that's a hostage video.
[grumbling] It's called leadership. You people wouldn't know a winner if...
[cutting in] Edwin, you're three and three. Sit down.
Today's picks. I'm on the over, one forty-two and a half, McNeese at Texas State. And U C L A, laying twenty-nine and a half to Delaware. Tax the rich, bet the over.
The machine and I like Southern Indiana, plus forty at Texas, and UMass Lowell, plus thirty and a half at Cincinnati. Steady, sensible, fully hydrated.
[dry] I'm with Brett on Lowell. And the under, one forty-seven and a half, Louisiana at U S C. Defense is like voting rights. You protect it every single night.
[muttering, out of breath] Youngstown State, plus two and a half at home. And the under, one sixty-four and a half. A guy at the bingo hall told me. Very strong guy. Tears in his eyes.
Edwin, nobody at the bingo hall has ever called you sir.
The board. I'm on top at five and one, up three and a half units. Merv's four and two. Brett and Edwin, three and three.
Yesterday everybody split, one and one. Edwin lost an over by half a point.
[warm] That's the Lock Call. The picks column is up right now at hardwood bricks dot com.
Twenty-one and up. If gambling's a problem, call one eight hundred GAMBLER.
Keep it mid. Keep it real.

news.item: At a White House briefing, President Trump praised new chief of staff Stephen Miller, said "We have breaking news - he was better than these two guys" while gesturing to Vice President Vance and Secretary of State Rubio standing behind him, and asked Miller "Do you wanna run for president?"

notes.board: Standings through Nov 21; yesterday = Nov 21 card.
